title: Vibrant Polish Pork Casserole
description: A comforting Polish dish featuring ginger garlic paste, pork, and vegetables in a winey sauce, all enclosed in a crispy crust, served in a tagliere and suitable for a keto diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the onion and mushrooms in butter until the onion is translucent.
Add the pork shoulder to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the ginger garlic paste, red wine, and beef broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the almond flour and egg to make the crust mixture.
Grease the tagliere with butter and add the crust mixture to the bottom and sides of the dish.
Add the pork and vegetable mixture to the tagliere and cover with the remaining crust mixture.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 45 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
